title: Every published number carries a dimension somebody reviewed
note: D-2026-57. The suffix rule these mutations restore was not hypothetical: it published gradient_K_per_m as metres and two fluxes as seconds, and lost the dimension of 91 of 162 numeric columns. A surviving mutation here means the test is asserting the shape of the inventory rather than what it decides. UI8 SURVIVED on the first run: every other test of the equivalence report reads the COMMITTED report, which a source change cannot move, so the refusal in validate_hdf5_equivalence.py had no test at all. The harness says a mis-scoped spec and a missing test look identical from there; this was the missing test, and it is now driven against a constructed one-column fixture with controls for each of the six legitimate dimensions.
